key_insight: DInf-Grid introduces a differentiable feature-grid representation that preserves the training speed of grid-based methods while enabling accurate, high-order derivative evaluation required for solving differential equations with neural solvers.
problem_solved: Coordinate-based MLP solvers (e.g., sinusoidal networks) are slow and compute-intensive, while existing grid-based alternatives train fast but rely on linear interpolation that cannot provide the higher-order derivatives needed for many differential-equation tasks. DInf-Grid addresses this gap by making feature grids differentiable with respect to coordinates and parameters so neural DE solvers can compute accurate gradients efficiently.
method: Replace traditional coordinate-MLPs with a compact feature grid representation that is differentiable wrt spatial coordinates and network parameters.
Use differentiable interpolation / reconstruction operators on the grid (supporting higher-order derivatives) so derivative evaluation required by DE solvers is accurate and efficient.

Integrate the differentiable grid into neural differential-equation solvers to retain fast training/inference of grid methods while enabling reliable computation of derivatives for integration and optimization.
impact: DInf-Grid lets practitioners solve PDEs/ODEs with neural methods much faster and with more reliable derivative information, reducing compute and training time while improving solver stability — especially useful for scientific ML, simulation, and physics-informed learning.
